answers: R-GP-IMPL-LAUNCHED-MARKER-2 R2-N1: a regular file that grows after the fstat size check was read to end-of-file
subject: packages/polaris-dossier/src/launched.ts
method: The round-2 harness and driver of syzygy-bpyt.8.8 with three race variants added and its two pre-8.8 skips removed. The harness runs once per side over 20 variants, and once per (variant, probe) in its own process group under a 120 s kill timeout for the two that blocked or exhausted the pre-8.8 reader (a FIFO; a symbolic link to /dev/zero); at c571fb9f neither can, so every probe runs at both sides. The base side writes the subject file from c571fb9f over the fix, then the fix is restored. A race variant replaces node:fs's fstatSync through the CommonJS module and syncBuiltinESMExports: at every fstat of a descriptor that names the marker (by /proc/self/fd) it writes the variant's first bytes into the file, takes the real fstat, then writes its second bytes, so every read of the marker in a probe loses the race. Each variant plants launched.json in a fresh run directory at a fixed path per probe; probes are public entry points present at both commits.
command: python3 drive.py <worktree> <base> <scratch> <out.json>; the harness is copied to packages/polaris-dossier/src/zz-b812-differential.test.ts and run with B88_BASE, B88_OUT and optionally B88_SKIP, B88_ONLY_VARIANT, B88_ONLY_PROBE set: npx vitest run --project @syzygy/polaris-dossier packages/polaris-dossier/src/zz-b812-differential.test.ts
attempts: This is the second run of the driver. The first, at the same commits, recorded harnessFailed for every probe of the FIFO variant at both sides: its plant returned execFileSync's output, which the restore step called as a function. The harness was corrected to keep only a returned function, and the whole run was repeated; the first run's output is not used.

round2Comparison.text: Every (variant, probe) of the round-2 record, compared with that record's fix side (cf3ba3fe, the reviewed head of syzygy-bpyt.8.8): this run's base side (c571fb9f, its merge) and this run's fix side.

changedOutcomes.text: Only the two variants whose marker grows past 4096 bytes after fstat change, and only from a launched run to a marker present but unreadable: a fail-closed change of an input that was already unsafe at c571fb9f, where the reader read the grown file to end-of-file. At c571fb9f such a marker counted a syzygy-launched form at launchFormRefusal; at the fix no form counts. The other three changed probes of each refuse at both commits and change only their reason. briefArmOff never opens the marker and is unchanged. The marker shrunk after fstat from 4097 bytes is refused by the fstat bound at both commits and is unchanged.
